title: Agenda
author: @lunokjod
description:
A perpetual calendar with events.
All-day, ranges, quarterly and yearly repeats.
The month on one screen with the days that have something marked, and the day of the month on another: the hour, all day or the span, then the note and whether it comes back. A finger turns the month and moves the year, the next event is promised to the alarm and the events live in a text file of the app, one line each, that a person can read and edit.
